caption: The drawing features two spoons, both rendered in shades of grey on a beige background. The upper spoon is depicted with its concave side facing up, showing an engraved detail at the end of the handle. The lower spoon is drawn with its convex side facing up, and there is a hallmark visible near the broader end of the handle. Both spoons have an elongated oval-shaped bowl and a handle that tapers gently and flares out at the end. Below the two larger spoon drawings, there is a small technical diagram that shows the top, side, and bottom views of a spoon, with measurements and a scale marked as 3/4 : 1. The border of the sheet is lined, and there is a signature or notation at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Spoon
